name: Kanzen Osu Dorei ~Kyuuketsuki Shimai to Osananajimi no Sei Gangu ni Sareta Boku~
original_name: 完全・雄・奴隷～吸血鬼姉妹と幼馴染の精玩具にされたボク～
source:
Faint-hearted, small and otaku protagonist suffers the harassment with abusive words from his childhood friend.
He wanted to change that, and he was intrigued by an ad on the Internet that said: "Do you want to change yourself? A simple test will tell your true self." Click by accident, he filled the forms.

At that time, nothing happened. He went to sleep and woke up to find a pretty vampire girl stepping upon his groin!?

This was the start of a week of sexual assault nightmare for him...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE109906.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
胆小、矮小的宅男主角饱受青梅竹马的辱骂骚扰。
他想要改变自己，被互联网上的一则广告所吸引：“想要改变自己吗？一个简单的测试就能揭示真实的你。”无意间点击后，他填写了表格。

当时什么也没发生。他去睡觉，醒来时发现一个漂亮的吸血鬼女孩正踩在他的裆部！？

这对他来说是一周性侵噩梦的开始……
